description: Curated early-career fellowships for PhD students and postdocs.
limitations: Checked against each funder's page on the date shown. Not exhaustive. Records without a confirmed date are program leads: read the official page before applying.

opportunities.title: Damon Runyon Fellowship Award
opportunities.description: Four-year fellowship for early postdoctoral scientists doing basic or translational cancer research.
opportunities.eligibility: Basic scientists apply within 18 months of their doctoral degree; physician-scientists after clinical training. Non-U.S. citizens must train at a U.S. institution. The 14 August 2026 round has passed; check the site for the next deadline.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Read the funder's current guidelines and confirm every eligibility rule before preparing an application.

opportunities.amount: Four-year stipend ($70,000 rising to $76,000) plus $2,000 yearly expenses

opportunities.title: Damon Runyon Quantitative Biology Fellowship Award
opportunities.description: Three-year fellowship for computational and quantitative scientists working on biological questions relevant to cancer, with dual mentorship.
opportunities.eligibility: Degree conferred between 1 Dec 2021 and 1 Dec 2026, and joined the mentor's lab on or after 1 Dec 2024. Reference letters are due by the deadline.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Read the funder's current guidelines and confirm every eligibility rule before preparing an application.

timing_evidence.detail: The application guidelines list a 1 December 2026 deadline and a 26 February 2027 selection meeting.

opportunities.title: Jane Coffin Childs Postdoctoral Fellowship
opportunities.funder: Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund for Medical Research
opportunities.description: Three-year fellowship for early postdocs in the medical and related sciences bearing on cancer.
opportunities.eligibility: Generally no more than one year of postdoctoral experience. Any nationality, but foreign nationals must train in the United States. The page lists a 1 February deadline without a year; confirm the current cycle.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Read the funder's current guidelines and confirm every eligibility rule before preparing an application.

opportunities.amount: $50,000 a year for three years, plus lab and travel allowances

opportunities.title: Helen Hay Whitney Foundation Postdoctoral Fellowship
opportunities.description: Three-year fellowship for early postdoctoral training in the basic biomedical sciences.
opportunities.eligibility: PhD within two years (MD within four) of the deadline and at most one year in the postdoctoral lab. Foreign citizens must train in U.S. labs. The 15 June 2026 round has passed.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Read the funder's current guidelines and confirm every eligibility rule before preparing an application.

opportunities.amount: Three years; stipend $73,000 rising to $77,000, plus allowances

opportunities.title: Life Sciences Research Foundation Postdoctoral Fellowship
opportunities.description: Three-year postdoctoral fellowships across the life sciences, funded by sponsoring companies, foundations and institutes.
opportunities.eligibility: PhD within the five-year window set for each cycle, in a different lab from the thesis lab. Non-U.S. citizens must work in a U.S. lab. The 1 October 2026 round has passed.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Read the funder's current guidelines and confirm every eligibility rule before preparing an application.

opportunities.title: HHMI Hanna H. Gray Fellows Program
opportunities.description: Supports postdocs in basic biological and biomedical research who intend to start an independent faculty career.
opportunities.eligibility: Current mentored postdoc at an HHMI-eligible institution, up to seven years of postdoctoral experience, intending to start a faculty position by May 2030. Must be authorized or eligible to work in the U.S.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Read the funder's current guidelines and confirm every eligibility rule before preparing an application.

timing_evidence.detail: HHMI's program page says applications are open and close 15 December 2026 at 5 PM ET.

opportunities.title: CRI Irvington Postdoctoral Fellowship
opportunities.description: Three-year fellowship for postdocs training in fundamental immunology or cancer immunology at nonprofit institutions worldwide.
opportunities.eligibility: Work must relate directly to immunology or cancer immunology. University notices describe two deadlines a year; the official page could not be reached on the check date, so confirm dates there.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Read the funder's current guidelines and confirm every eligibility rule before preparing an application.

opportunities.title: AACR John and Elizabeth Leonard Basic Cancer Research Fellowship
opportunities.description: Two-year fellowship for postdoctoral and clinical research fellows doing mentored basic cancer research. The listed deadline is for the letter of intent.
opportunities.eligibility: Read the program guidelines for career-stage and AACR membership rules. Full applications are by invitation after the letter of intent.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Read the funder's current guidelines and confirm every eligibility rule before preparing an application.

timing_evidence.detail: AACR's grants page lists a 24 November 2026 letter of intent and a 15 March 2027 application deadline.

opportunities.title: Breast Cancer Research Foundation–AACR Career Development Awards
opportunities.description: Three-year career development award for breast cancer research. The listed deadline is for the letter of intent.
opportunities.eligibility: Career-stage rules are in the program guidelines; career development awards usually target early independent investigators rather than trainees.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Read the funder's current guidelines and confirm every eligibility rule before preparing an application.

timing_evidence.detail: AACR's grants page lists a 15 December 2026 letter of intent and a 1 April 2027 application deadline.

opportunities.title: Burroughs Wellcome Fund Career Awards at the Scientific Interface
opportunities.description: Bridges advanced postdoctoral training and the first years of a faculty post for researchers from the physical, mathematical, computational or engineering sciences who work on biological questions.
opportunities.eligibility: Postdoctoral experience window applies (12–60 months by the full-application deadline in the 2027 cycle). The 2027 letter-of-intent deadline (14 Aug 2026) has passed; full proposals are by invitation.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Read the funder's current guidelines and confirm every eligibility rule before preparing an application.

opportunities.title: HFSP Long-Term and Cross-Disciplinary Fellowships
opportunities.description: Three-year fellowships for postdocs who move to a new country for basic life-science research. Cross-Disciplinary Fellowships are for those trained outside biology.
opportunities.eligibility: Doctorate within three years of the full-proposal deadline, a lead-author paper, and a move to a different country from the PhD. The 2027-cycle letter-of-intent deadline has passed.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Read the funder's current guidelines and confirm every eligibility rule before preparing an application.

opportunities.title: Humboldt Research Fellowship
opportunities.description: Funds researchers of any discipline and any non-German nationality for a research stay at a host in Germany.
opportunities.eligibility: Postdocs within four years of the doctorate; experienced researchers within twelve years. Fewer than 90 days in Germany in the previous 18 months. Calls close early once 800 applications arrive.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Read the funder's current guidelines and confirm every eligibility rule before preparing an application.

opportunities.amount: €3,000 a month for postdocs (€3,600 experienced researchers), 6–24 months

timing_evidence.detail: Calls open on 15 March, 15 July and 15 November and close early once 800 applications are received.

opportunities.title: Schmidt Science Fellows
opportunities.description: Interdisciplinary postdoctoral placement for people finishing a STEM PhD who want to pivot into a new field.
opportunities.eligibility: Candidates must be nominated by their PhD-awarding institution. The 2027-cohort deadlines (May–July 2026) have passed; universities usually open internal nominations early in the year.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Ask your PhD-granting university's research or fellowships office about its internal nomination round.

opportunities.title: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP)
opportunities.description: Five-year award with three years of support for graduate study in NSF-supported science and engineering fields.
opportunities.eligibility: For students at the start of graduate study. Citizenship and career-stage limits are in the current Notice of Funding Opportunity. The October 2026 field deadlines have closed.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Read the funder's current guidelines and confirm every eligibility rule before preparing an application.

opportunities.amount: $37,000 stipend plus $16,000 cost of education a year, for three years of support

opportunities.title: Hertz Foundation Graduate Fellowship
opportunities.description: Doctoral fellowship in the applied physical, biological and engineering sciences and mathematics.
opportunities.eligibility: Doctoral students and those applying to doctoral programs. Citizenship and timing rules are on the foundation's eligibility page.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Read the funder's current guidelines and confirm every eligibility rule before preparing an application.

opportunities.amount: Up to five years of support, valued up to $250,000

opportunities.eligibility: U.S. citizens or nationals pursuing a doctorate at a U.S. institution. The FY2027 window (3 Aug–30 Oct 2026) has closed.
